title: Kasuwa
description: A direct-to-buyer agricultural marketplace connecting producers directly with bulk purchasers and consumers.
challenge: Agricultural producers struggled with fragmented distribution channels and opaque pricing, while buyers faced inconsistent quality and high communication friction.
approach: Architected a direct-to-buyer digital marketplace with structured inventory listings, transparent vendor communication, and an intuitive mobile-first transaction flow.
result: A fast, credible marketplace interface engineered to turn casual visits into reliable trading relationships without intermediary bottlenecks.

title: ROOT//NODE
description: A one-shot optical messenger: one device flashes a message as a burst of QR symbols, the other reads it with its camera. No server, no account, no network.
challenge: Every 'private' messenger still needs an account, a relay server and a network path that can be observed, logged or blocked.
approach: Split each message into 80-byte chunks sealed with AES-GCM under an HKDF-SHA-256 handshake, binding the frame index as additional authenticated data and closing with a SHA-256 trailer. Every symbol is pre-rendered before playback so nothing is encoded mid-flash.
result: A working air-gapped channel where a reordered, dropped or spliced frame is rejected instead of silently accepted - shipped with an honest statement of what a browser app cannot protect.

title: Sotion
description: A file-evidence service for disputed media: it reports what an image file establishes, what the public record says about it, and what no check can establish.
challenge: Detector tools promise a true/false verdict on authenticity that the underlying evidence cannot actually support.
approach: Built a FastAPI pipeline where every finding is an EvidenceUnit carrying the rule that produced it - EXIF geometry against the pixel buffer, compression evidence, copy-move regions, C2PA signature validity - resolved into a five-value verdict, each with an explicit 'what this establishes / what it does not'.
result: A precision-first product with pre-registered evaluation gates: when the general synthetic-detection track failed its validation gates it was closed and documented, rather than shipped as an overclaim.

title: Liora
description: A multi-jurisdictional AI legal research platform designed to streamline complex legal analysis across different regions.
challenge: Legal teams cross-referencing multi-jurisdictional precedents spend excessive time parsing dense documentation and rigid legacy databases.
approach: Designed a distraction-free research workspace prioritizing typographic clarity, contextual citations, and structured query workflows.
result: A high-density research interface designed to reduce cognitive fatigue and accelerate multi-jurisdiction statutory analysis.

title: TradingPal
description: A modern financial interface with real-time data visualization, portfolio tracking, and a clean analytical dashboard.
challenge: Traders are often overwhelmed by cluttered interfaces that obscure high-priority market signals and delay critical execution.
approach: Engineered a low-latency interface with strict visual hierarchy, customizable real-time charts, and clean portfolio metrics.
result: A streamlined financial dashboard delivering real-time clarity and dependable data visualization across desktop and mobile screens.
